profile.headline: Software Engineer at Northstrat
profile.summary: I’m a software engineer with a background and interest in math and physics. My experience is primarily in Java, Python, and C++.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, development, and maintenance of satellite ground system software written primarily in Java and C++ in a Linux environment using agile and waterfall development processes.
• Lead algorithm developer for a capability aimed at marking and scoring polygon intersections, leveraged by multiple programs within the company.
• Lead developer on an effort to automate user workflows, resource allocation, and task scheduling.
• Lead maintainer of component exposing processed signal data to external users via a web service.
• Created dynamic logging levels by subscribing applications to messages published on a new JMS topic.
• Enhanced polar scatterplot Java application, enabling selection and zooming with an elliptic wedge shape.
• Configured JUnit test suite to build and run through an ant target and run nightly in Jenkins.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design, development, and maintenance of satellite ground system software written in Java, C++, and Python in a Linux environment using agile and waterfall development processes.
• Led development that finished one month early and passed all requirements during integration testing.
• Created XML parser using C++ Xerces libraries to make software run-time configurable.
• Modified Java Swing GUI login to authenticate user credentials through an LDAP server query.
• Wrote Python testing script to expose longstanding bug with least squares fitting algorithm.
• Implemented and automated unit and regression tests using C++ Boost test libraries, Junit, and Jenkins.
• Earned achievement award for ensuring factory acceptance testing finished ahead of schedule, resulting in a $700k incentive award for the program.

positions.title: Application Engineer / Developer
positions.description:
• Development of finite-difference time-domain electromagnetic simulation software written in C++.
• Implemented algorithm to implicitly update a linear dielectric plasma model on a 3D grid in time.
• Updated C++ classes to use validation methods for improved parameter checking and user help, including some refactoring to create a more intuitive inheritance structure.
• Developed Python post-processing data analysis scripts such as signal processing filters.
• Supported research projects in accelerator and plasma physics, including running simulations on a cluster.

positions.title: Senior Analyst
positions.description: Modeled and simulated energy utility portfolios for risk management and asset valuation using Monte Carlo and time series methods, including thermal and renewable generation and financial hedging.

positions.title: Scientist
positions.description:
• Conducted laboratory and range testing of counter improvised explosive device systems.
• Researched emerging technologies to brief special operations customers.
